title: Clockwork Sanctuary: The Sentinel's Meridian Key
premise: In an overgrown observatory driven by silent brass escapements, the sentinel must escort witnesses through guarded crossings using a oath-bound signal shield.
ending: Recover the Meridian Key and return with the civilian refuge record; Custodians of Dawn can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive charged gearfall while evading the watchmaker automaton without sacrificing the civilian refuge record.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Custodians of Dawn to witness the oath-bound signal shield.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to stand guard or pursue the artifact
